verdict.rationale: pnpm is a command-line package manager with no graphical UI and no hosted service, so asking whether a programmatic API matches the UI does not apply to this kind of product. The CLI is the only interface (pnpm-probe-4), and the absence of an OpenAPI spec (pnpm-probe-3) reflects that it is not a hosted service, not a parity gap.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
